Three means a crowd: each row belongs together by restrained costume/material motif and complementary personality, but each actor must function independently outside group. No handoffs, pointing at neighbour, overlaps or shared objects.

Hands are goo continuous with body. No humanoid torso/legs/feet/busts, no whole coats/robes hiding goo. Dark ink face/body dominant, accessories small and readable. Every OPEN eye has WHITE/ivory sclera surrounding separate RED iris and BLACK pupil. Planned cyclops has same colour rule. No all-red/glowing eyeballs. Offbeat absurd/surreal satirical peak acting, not generic cute Pixar babies, no repeated V-brow tooth grin. Differentiate body contour, eye/lid shapes, mouth, posture and temperament BEFORE props. Some mouths closed, some open, unequal gazes; NO protruding tongue in ANY cell.

Centres(256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Never cross x512,x1024,y512. Similar overall body size, no giant boss. Few bold simple functional handmade props, rich softly rounded wood/metal/cloth, not machinery clutter. Entire figure isolated, no floor/cast shadows/scenelet/scenery/extra heads.

TOP ROW TRIO: Macbeth · Krone, Fleck, Vorhersage. Context: Shakespeare Macbeth, loose KFB archetypal interpretation; no actor likeness. SHARED restrained belonging cue: tiny faded TERRACOTTA cloth accents and worn copper trim linking three different tragic archetypes.

Panicked side-looking WHITE/red/black eyes and crooked clenched teeth. Tiny battered copper CROWN tilted too far, short terracotta plaid collar. Holds ONE short thick dull ceremonial DAGGER low at own belly, no blood/action/victim.
MIDDLE: A DIFFERENT FEMALE-READ Lady Macbeth archetype: relentless guilt manager. TALL narrow upright ink pear, TWO smooth rolled crown lobes, heavy lashes, ONE sharp upper ivory tooth. Fixed cold wide gaze DOWN, CLOSED taut crooked lip. Tiny terracotta velvet-like collar with copper clasp, one little ivory hairpin. Both hands squeeze ONE large worn IVORY SOAP BAR over ONE tiny cream wash bowl held against own belly, no water scene.
RIGHT: A DIFFERENT FEMALE-READ witch archetype: cheerful ambiguous oracle. SHORT ROUND upright ink dumpling, crown nubs under SMALL crooked dark-plum witch cap with terracotta patch, lashes, THREE sparse upper teeth. One WHITE/red/black eye wide and one squint shut, mischievous asymmetrical OPEN laugh with NO tongue. Hugs ONE small round black clay CAULDRON with fat copper rim and ONE very short wooden spoon, no smoke/spell FX.

BOTTOM ROW TRIO: Hamlet · Frage, Zeuge, Altlast. Context: Shakespeare Hamlet, loose KFB archetypal interpretation; no actor likeness. SHARED restrained belonging cue: small midnight-blue collars, worn IVORY and dull brass props, different faces/body contours.
LEFT: A DIFFERENT male Hamlet archetype: prince of deferred decisions. TALL bent upright ink bean, ONE long drooping crown lobe, one big upper tooth and tiny lower fang. Unequal wide WHITE/red/black eyes looking DOWN, heavy uncertain CLOSED pout. Tiny dark cap with short ivory feather and small blue princely collar. Holds ONE simple rounded little IVORY THEATRICAL SKULL at belly, no bones/gore elsewhere.
MIDDLE: A DIFFERENT male Horatio archetype: patient witness. WIDE low upright ink splat with three blunt crown nubs, tiny navy soft cap, TWO offset upper teeth. Weary knowing half-lidded side gaze and CLOSED little crooked lip. Holds ONE small plain leather NOTEBOOK and ONE fat ivory quill, no writing/text.
RIGHT: A DIFFERENT male ghost-father archetype: unresolved authority. MEDIUM upright round-bottom ink bell, TWO backward crown curls, huge lower lip and ONE tiny upper fang. Stern affronted one-brow glare, CLOSED downturned lip. Small battered GREY knight brow helmet with broken brass crest and very short navy collar; one goo hand holds ONE fat old brass KEY, no transparency/ghost FX, no full armour.
EMPTY BACKGROUND AND HOLES ACTUAL ALPHA0, interiors opaque with soft antialiased outer edge only. No gradient/matte/checkerboard/floor/shadowdiscs, no lettering/numbers/logos/labels/borders or floating punctuation. Six complete distinct characters, two coherent TRIOS, exactly TWO female-read figures in sheet. Body/face individuality first; group relationship second; simple iconic props third.
SPACING PRIORITY OVERRIDE: sparse contact sheet with SMALL FIGURES, each only about65percent of its cell height, ample empty gaps. COMPLETE actor+props bounding box MAX340x340, at least86px transparent padding INSIDE each512cell. Don't fill the sheet, don't let any prop reach another row or column.
